scenario: Credential dumping + lateral movement + service persistence
summary: On 2026-09-10, PowerShell on WS-OPS-01 launched procdump.exe against lsass.exe (process access, event 10) and wrote lsass.dmp. ~20 min later the same PowerShell session opened SMB connections to SRV-FILE-01; four failed NTLM network logons for CORP\jdoe (4625, type 3) were followed by a successful one (4624). A remote service 'UpdaterSvc2' was then installed on SRV-FILE-01 (sc.exe, ImagePath registry value under Services) and the binary C:\Windows\Temp\updatersvc2.exe executed as SYSTEM under services.exe.
